svg.title: When a check fails or stops
svg.desc: When a run of the checks or of the release ends, the bots after the checks look at how. Tests that failed or ran out of time at first run their failed jobs once more, unless the same jobs broke for the commit before; a job that passes then goes into the issue of flaky tests with its step, its test and its error, and one that fails again stays red. A required check that a late run for an older commit cancelled starts again. A job of another check that ran out of time at the first attempt runs once more. The release of a merge that failed runs its failed jobs once more, where they stopped.
